## FSB Directory

```{r fsb-directory}
# Read the Accountancy directory first
accountancy_url = "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Accountancy/all"

accountancy_page = rvest::read_html(accountancy_url)

# Extract the department from the first column
accountancy_departments = accountancy_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table td:first-child") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

# Select the links containing people's names
accountancy_links = accountancy_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table td:nth-child(3) strong a")

# Extract the name text
accountancy_names = accountancy_links |>
  rvest::html_text2()

# Extract each person's position
accountancy_positions = accountancy_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table td:nth-child(3) i") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

# Extract the website linked to each person's name
accountancy_websites = accountancy_links |>
  rvest::html_attr("href")

# Check that all four fields have the same number of values
length(accountancy_departments)
length(accountancy_names)
length(accountancy_positions)
length(accountancy_websites)

# Combine the fields into one data frame
accountancy_df = data.frame(
  department = accountancy_departments,
  name = accountancy_names,
  position = accountancy_positions,
  website = accountancy_websites
)

head(accountancy_df)
```

# All Departments

```{r all-departments}
# Department values used in the directory URLs
department_paths = c(
  "Accountancy" = "Accountancy",
  "Economics" = "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship" = "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance" = "Finance",
  "Information Systems & Analytics" =
    "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing" = "Marketing",
  "Management" = "Management"
)

# Extract one department using the selectors checked above
scrape_department = function(department_path) {
  directory_url = paste0(
    "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/",
    department_path,
    "/all"
  )

  directory_page = rvest::read_html(directory_url)

  person_links = directory_page |>
    rvest::html_elements("table td:nth-child(3) strong a")

  department_result = data.frame(
   department = rep(
  names(department_paths)[match(department_path, department_paths)],
  length(person_links)
),

    name = person_links |>
      rvest::html_text2(),

    position = directory_page |>
      rvest::html_elements("table td:nth-child(3) i") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),

    website = person_links |>
      rvest::html_attr("href")
  )

  Sys.sleep(1)

  return(department_result)
}

# Apply the function to all seven departments
department_results = purrr::map(
  department_paths,
  scrape_department
)

# Combine the results into a single data frame
fsb_directory = dplyr::bind_rows(department_results)

# Required assignment output
head(fsb_directory)

# Confirm all seven departments appear and see their row counts
fsb_directory |>
  dplyr::count(department)

# Check for missing or blank fields
fsb_directory |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      ~ sum(is.na(.x) | trimws(.x) == "")
    )
  )
```
